body.objective: Freeze Paper 9 and its publication evidence against the final Phase 1 counterflow health-based receiver nonactivation, without opening another observer architecture or manufacturing an operational observable on an unstable carrier.
body.stop_condition: Import PHASE1_RELATIONAL_OBSERVABLE_DISPOSITION_SYNTHESIS_V1 and COUNTERFLOW_CHARGED_TIME_PHYSICAL_INSTANTIATION_AFTER_REPAIRED_Q70_HEALTH_NOT_ACTIVATED_V1, their payloads, receipts, terminal lifecycle events and six transitive action-derived health inputs by exact hashes. Build the authoritative machine-readable Paper 9 claim map, classifying every material statement as CONDITIONAL_THEOREM, KINEMATIC_FIXTURE, LOCAL_BV_CLASS, ACTION_INTEGRATION, PHYSICAL_DESCENT, OPERATIONAL_OBSERVABLE, NOT_ACTIVATED or OPEN. Reconcile the main TeX, computational supplement and observer Phase 1 paper-coverage record so they state together that all certified repaired-q70 receiver blocks are unstable, fixed Q_rel removes the clock, j>=3/2 has NO_CERTIFIED_MAP, and therefore the thirteen-field operational frequency-ratio domain is empty at the tested point. Preserve the valid conditional charged-time/event-map theorems and carrier-scoped legacy responses. Add result-to-paper edges and materiality annotations for the new health certificate and every imported observer headline/negative result; classify any uncovered result explicitly rather than silently omitting it. Provide an independent claim-map verifier, stale-healthy-carrier/coordinate-redshift/K-equals-D mutations, exact source-hash checks, two consecutive warning-free builds of the main paper and supplement, a scoped paper-coverage replay, receipt and referee-style freeze report deciding THEOREM_FROZEN or the exact remaining DRAFT_ALLOWED gates.
body.current_gate: Phase 1 publication-current Paper 9 claim and evidence freeze after the terminal counterflow health audit
body.forbid: no new receiver, suspension, apparatus, compensator or action architecture; no retuned healthy point assumed before Classical certifies one; no unstable or undefined block promoted as a receiver; no coordinate-frequency ratio called redshift; no fixed-charge quotient presented as retaining the relative clock; no K/raw-D conflation; no local BV cocycle called an operational observable; no particle, quantum, phenomenology or unitarity claim; no paper cosmetics substituted for claim/evidence verification
